$comment: Savant constitution. Operator-only. Changed exclusively by git commit + deploy. Doctrine may tighten, never loosen, these values. Validated at boot by src/contracts/constitution.ts; its SHA-256 is journaled on every boot.

untouchables.name: no-contract-no-order
untouchables.rule: Every order must trace to a schema-valid DecisionContract persisted before submission.

untouchables.name: models-never-size
untouchables.rule: Model outputs may set conviction and probabilities only. Quantity, notional and price come solely from the deterministic sizer and validator.

untouchables.name: hard-caps-cash-only
untouchables.rule: Per-trade risk, total heat, position notional, daily loss and drawdown caps below are absolute. Cash only: no margin, no shorting, no naked options, no leveraged products. Bearish exposure only by buying the 1x inverse ETFs listed in allowed.inverse_etfs_1x (ADR-040).

untouchables.name: every-position-has-an-exit
untouchables.rule: Every position carries a stop: broker-side where Alpaca accepts one, synthetic otherwise, checked every pulse.

untouchables.name: kill-switch-sacred
untouchables.rule: The kill-switch and RED breaker cannot be overridden by any model or Governor. LIVE unlock requires an operator-written postmortem. PAPER, which runs fully autonomously, unlocks itself only after the minimum cooldown, once flat, with a machine postmortem; every RED trip counts against LIVE graduation.

untouchables.name: fail-closed
untouchables.rule: Stale data, unknown broker state, reconciliation mismatch, or any free-tier budget at or above the hard-stop fraction forces REDUCE_ONLY. Never fail open.

untouchables.name: append-only-journal
untouchables.rule: Journal tables are append-only and hash-chained. No UPDATE or DELETE. The daily chain head is anchored externally (Discord).

untouchables.name: self-modification-needs-approval
untouchables.rule: The Governor may only propose changes; the operator approves them (a pull request on the publisher's own deployment, an approval in the app on a customer's install). Proposals can only tighten: calibration maps may only lower confidence, scar rules may only reject. There is no approve-each-trade mode. LIVE joins at Stop 0 and trades only after the operator ratifies it (RATIFY on a fresh sign-in); the paper graduation gate is shown to the operator as advice before ratifying. Capital-ladder promotions also need ratification.
